Good Discovery and Bad News (Good Discovery and Bad News (Page 22)) Xia Tian closed her glasses. At this moment, she was no longer nervous. What else was she nervous about? Anyway, she was going to die anyway. Qin Yun's voice became cold, she subconsciously got up and walked to He came to Qin Qing's side and protected her behind him. Countless pieces of flesh and blood, together with the crossbow arrows, the poisonous ox hair needles, and the twisted steel knives, flew towards more than five level five hunters outside the inn door. Only by teaming up with dragons can we defeat a black dragon. Shu Feng killed those black dragons with ease. "It sounds like you are doing well recently. How is the preparation of the private restaurant?" Jiang Feng asked. He violated this rule by leaving during the game. "I can't let others see my treatment, including my family..." Shen Yun said without hesitation. However, he secretly spit out the tea that he had just sipped in his mouth, and covered it up with a handkerchief calmly. However, in Tang Que's view, Zhi Beiyou's situation was not very good. Although he was a guest of General Tao's house in Beimang, After all, he was living under someone else's roof. If the master and four reasonable people were okay, he was afraid of meeting a fool like Tao Yun. There were too many things involved. After Jun Mochen came out of seclusion, he couldn't wait for Luo Yan to come out of seclusion and return to Yaowang Valley, so he rushed directly to the tenth peak of the Demon Realm. Waiting for Luo Yan. Shen Qingyu seemed to have received Chu Ning's gaze, curled her lips, and pretended to carelessly help the hair on her shoulders. This move made Chu Ning see more clearly. "Xuan Bingbing?!" Shen Yingtian saw Xuan Bingbing. Suddenly he understood, it turned out that the person who had attracted Big Brother's attention just now was Xuan Bingbing. The Bull Demon King's horns were one of yin and one of yang. The horn he cut off was obviously yang, because there was a hot and yang-like aura spreading out of it.
